# auro-hyperlink — translation of unaddressed options (placeholder)

Judgement-based translations, not name-matched ones, so none of this is bound yet. Replace each `TBD` with `attr="value"` (forward table) or `Property = Option` (reverse tables), or `n/a` if there is no code equivalent. Items marked **verify** are lower confidence and should be checked against the design or the component source before binding. Rows are generated by `build-translate.mjs`, which only adds missing rows and never edits existing ones (it only comments rows that look obsolete; `--prune` removes those whose target is gone).

| Figma property | Figma option | Translation (attribute = value) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| State | Default | n/a | No code counterpart. In all three Hyperlink sets, State is not a code attribute (it only paired with `appearance` through a coincidental `default` option). |
| State | Focused | n/a | Pseudo-state (`:focus-visible`), not an attribute. |
| State | Hover | n/a | Pseudo-state (`:hover`), not an attribute. |
| Inverse | False | TBD |  |
| Inverse | True | TBD |  |
| Size | Default | `size="md"` | CTA Button only. `md` is the code default, so the attribute can be omitted. **verify** |
| Size | Small | `size="sm"` | CTA Button only. **verify** |
| Rounded | Yes | TBD |  |
| Rounded | No | TBD |  |
| Inverse | No | TBD |  |
| Inverse | Yes | TBD |  |
